articles.title: Hunter Biden debuts 'LAPTOP' memecoin targeting TRUMP holders
articles.snippet: LAPTOP debuts Wednesday on Base, with nearly a third of the supply set to be burned if a slate of political and market outcomes — including a Democratic win in 2028 — comes good.

articles.title: Polish prosecutors charge fifth suspect in a massive crypto probe
articles.snippet: BitBay became Zondacrypto in 2021. The exchange stopped trading in April after customers faced frozen withdrawals and estimated losses of at least $94 million.

articles.title: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades
articles.snippet: A Transaction v1 feature activates Wednesday, allowing complex proofs and large multisig operations to fit in one transaction while forcing services that read Solana to update.

articles.title: Bitcoin struggles at $83,000 'wall' as whales flip into net selling
articles.snippet: All wallet cohorts have shifted into net distribution for the first time since early June, but a potential golden cross offers bulls some hope.

articles.title: Once-hyped Ethereum rival Harmony wants to shut its blockchain over AI threats
articles.snippet: Developers want to voluntarily shut down the network, saying state actors and AI agents have made security too difficult, then redirect ONE emissions into an AI video business.
